exposure: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) in pregnant women
cohort: The study involved 450 pregnant women recruited from December 2022 to February 2023.
finding: Infants of mothers with PTSD during pregnancy exhibited significantly lower weight percentiles at three months postpartum compared to infants of mothers without PTSD.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured and adjusted for in the analysis, with no statistically significant difference between the PTSD and non-PTSD groups at birth.
